messages:
nina: Quick onboarding pain: fresh WSL dev box, installed redwoodctl, ran `redwoodctl local-test --mount ./data:/app/data` and hit two problems: the mount was empty inside the runtime and the CLI fell into an interactive device-code flow that blocked our self-hosted CI.

nina: Using redwoodctl v0.30.2, WSL2 Ubuntu, runner workspace is a symlink to /mnt/ssd/workspace.

olek: sounds like the symlink + dind combo. Did you try `realpath ./data` and passing the absolute path to --mount? Also which auth mode do you have?

nina: tried realpath, docker run -v $(realpath ./data):/check busybox ls /check shows files, but `redwoodctl local-test` still sees empty dir. Logs: `WARN runtime: mount appears empty after start`.

olek: redwoodctl uses an internal shim that may rewrite mounts for the inner daemon; when the host path is through a symlinked workspace the inner docker daemon can see a different canonical path. Workaround: set REDWOOD_LOCAL_MOUNTS=$(realpath ./data) so the CLI will passthrough that exact path.

nina: that fixed the mount locally. For CI the worse bit was auth: refresh got a 401 then it printed the device code URL and waited forever. CI has no browser so job hung.

olek: short-term: pre-auth in CI and export REDWOOD_TOKEN from `redwoodctl auth login --service-account-key "$SA_KEY" --output token`. Example step: `echo "REDWOOD_TOKEN=$(redwoodctl auth login --service-account-key \"$SA_KEY\" --output token)" >> $GITHUB_ENV`. That keeps jobs noninteractive and causes CLI to fail fast on mount errors.

devx-bot: Filed infra#4230: make CLI respect CI/noninteractive (env var REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE=noninteractive) and return a clear nonzero exit instead of launching device flow. Filed infra#4231: document REDWOOD_LOCAL_MOUNTS for dind/symlink workarounds.

ci-bot: Rerun scheduled with REDWOOD_TOKEN set; will report back if mount still empty.

nina: Thanks, will add a tiny note to the onboarding doc with the CI snippet and the docker run -v check. If infra adds a noninteractive error path that'd be ideal. :thumbsup:
